notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Version 0.0.8 is now live with the following changes:

Added:


 Colorblind filter

 Audio description (still in Beta)

 Configuration for Xbox and PlayStation controller support


Bug Fixes:


 HUD adjustments (positioning, images, and fixes for elements that appeared in the wrong order)

 General fixes (extra life not being counted, objects not respawning when lost, bug where Maria would freeze while carrying objects, delay when dismounting the horse, horse entering water, and bug where Maria could dash in the farm area)

 Camera adjustments


Farm Area Updates:


 Increased rune particle effects for better visibility

 Adjusted climbing position on the island

 Reworked jump area in the abandoned zone to improve training and camera transition


Swamp Area Updates:


 Zanthra’s quest reworked for better navigation

 Skill gain HUD redesigned and correctly positioned


Added sound control
